info.title: UpgradeMap — .NET migration scanner
info.description: Know what breaks before you migrate. UpgradeMap scans a .NET solution and reports the migration blockers (WebForms, WCF, BinaryFormatter, COM interop, AppDomain/Remoting — with file and line), NuGet package verdicts against modern .NET, a dependency-ordered upgrade sequence, and evidence-backed effort bands. Runs locally; your source code never leaves the machine. Emits a console summary, a self-contained HTML report, or JSON for CI.
